description: REGIME-CASH: regime definitions, cash budgets, entry/exit gates. All money-affecting knobs live here for OPT sweeps.

add_risk.note: Factor-based BUY add sizing into existing stacks. Clips/skips adds only — never force-sells open bags. Budgets: open_upnl*k_profit, equity*h_add, book heat H_book, target weight room, cash_frac, rebalance_cap.

cautious_flat.note: Brad 2026-08-25 cautious path: in flat only, auto-merge hard SELLs when RSI crosses up through overbought after entry, mark green (r>=0), held >=24h. Bull/bear/transition stay operator loop. Quality filters also drop low-quality shadow proposals.

hard_exit.note: H3 cautious flat (2026-08-25): operator_approve remains true globally; flat may auto-apply when cautious_flat gates pass. Bull/bear never auto from this path. park_prefer_reduce NEVER auto.

detector.note: Layers soft_up/climb/pre_bull refine upside transition. soft_down is first-class live regime (de-risk $35). transition = upside residual only (deploy $75). Brad 2026-08-24 signed residual.

flat.label: Flat — cautious gated deploy (operator thaw 2026-07-18 B)
flat.notes: Not full park-off. RSI/sentiment gates enforce; small cap. Analyst OPT may propose tighter/looser knobs — promote only via gates.

transition.label: Transition — gated deploy (flat-like; Brad thaw 2026-08-24)
transition.notes: Upside residual only (+flat…+bull). Downside residual is soft_down.

soft_down.label: Soft-down — de-risk sleeve (flat→bear strip; Brad 2026-08-24)
soft_down.notes: Thin band bear_cut < BTC30d < -flat (~−10…−8). Not full park (whipsaw); not flat $75. Half-ish flat cap, tighter gates, no pyramid. Dual-peak/SL still bind. Full park at bear.

continuous.note: RC-06 COMPLETE: continuous scorecard→knob_map→cash policy suggestions (sweep)→gated to leaderboard/proposals (cash_policy_suggestions.py). Weekly OPT chain updated. Promote only via gates; manual apply to policy JSON.
